limitations: Single-user alpha: original ArtCraft UI previews can be registered separately; original UI/server processing and provider parity are pending.
RapidRAW is not bundled: its independent Linux installation remains a separate CLI workflow.

FilmCraft and the bounded DesignCraft PAR-03 bridge are separate Actions-built browser preview archives. DesignCraft now routes original file.new, graphic frame.create, selection.set, edit.selectAll, text.placeCaret and text.insert through bounded ACKed worker actions with canonical state/render hydration; only these bounded workflows are evidenced, while other original tools/actions, provider/save parity and recovery remain pending. These are not complete server-backed original-app bundles.
The native laptop mount helper is not bundled. Use upload or copy-first mode; on-demand/hybrid mounts require a separately installed and verified helper.
CI smoke tests use generated documents; real browser folder permissions and broad format compatibility require separate acceptance.
Linux requires glibc 2.35+; Windows requires the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 x64 runtime; macOS bundle targets Apple Silicon on macOS 14+.

Alpha.52 remains a draft prerelease because real browser folder permission, laptop write ACK/recovery, provider parity and full original-app acceptance remain incomplete; it is not a complete creative suite.

Alpha.52 adds the original DesignCraft Text Tool `text.delete` server ACK action; alpha.48 adds the original DesignCraft Edit > Select All server ACK action; alpha.47's Actions workflow builds the original SoundCraft v0.7.0 browser preview at its reviewed pin; session editing, audio decode/DSP, playback and export run in browser WASM. Server-owned session/actions/DSP/decode/mix/export, bounded media streaming, providers, write ACK/recovery, native OS support and full parity remain pending for SoundCraft, as do acceptance gates for the other original previews.
